user.title: berse
user.description: Configure one mainland Portugal electricity installation. Choose a cumulative sensor or enter manual kWh for the full billing period. The sensor is optional in manual mode; manual kWh is ignored in sensor mode. All prices exclude VAT.

init.title: Consumption, offers and notifications
init.description: Manual kWh applies to the full configured billing period and does not require a sensor. Manual kWh is ignored in sensor mode. Indexed offers are estimates. All prices exclude VAT.
